name: Super Star Party
longDescription: Super Star Party is a free party board game for up to 4 players that runs right in your browser. Built with AI, with nothing to install: open it and play.
about: Super Star Party is a free party board game for 1 to 4 players that runs in your browser on a phone or computer, with nothing to install. Characters race around the board collecting coins and buying stars. Every turn ends with a minigame, from Bumper Balls and Cake Dash to Memory Match and Pipe Puzzle, and the winner takes coins. Computer players fill any empty seats. At the end, bonus stars are handed out and the player with the most stars wins.
howItWasMade: Built with AI coding agents: builder agents write each piece, and critic agents judge it against a Mario Party 7 quality bar and name the biggest gap. Its art, animation and sound are generated in code by default, with exported 3D models where needed.

name: Flag Catch
description: 3D capture the flag with animal teams
longDescription: Flag Catch is a free 3D capture the flag game that runs right in your browser. Pick an animal, sneak into enemy land, grab a flag and race it home. Built with AI, with nothing to install.
about: Flag Catch is a free capture the flag game for phones and computers, with nothing to install. You pick an animal (a lion on a quad bike, a mammoth on a skateboard, a narwhal, a bat and more) and join a team of 8 to 64 against a rival team on an island split into three lands. Sneak into enemy land, grab a flag and carry it home while firecrackers, power ups and defenders try to stop you. Medics plant respawn flags, Hoard mode plays to a points target, and Playful mode is one flag a side. Eight worlds, from Home Isle to a lava island, open up as you earn points. It plays best on a phone held sideways.
howItWasMade: Built with AI coding agents in phases, from the core rules to worlds, animals, menus and sound. Every model, animation, sound and song is generated in code with three.js and Web Audio, with no art files.
